Consul General Chen Li Attends “The Path Forward 2026” China-U.S. Business Exchange Event
On July 16, Consul General Chen Li attended “The Path Forward 2026” China-U.S. business exchange event hosted by the China General Chamber of Commerce-USA and delivered a keynote speech.
Consul General Chen Li Engages with Ohio’s Agricultural Community
On June 26, Consul General Chen Li visited the Ohio Soybean Council and held in-depth discussions with soybean farmers and cattlemen on issues including China-U.S. agricultural trade.
Consul General Chen Li Visit Pittsburgh
From June 24 to 25, 2026, Chen Li, the Chinese Consul General in New York, visited Pittsburgh. During the visit, he met with Mayor O'Connor, as well as executives from Block Communications and PPG Industries.The U.S.side said that they welcomed the stability of bilateral relations, and hoped to deepen cooperation in sister-city ties, trade, and people-to-people exchanges.
Consul General Chen Li Attends the Opening Ceremony of the 47th Boston Hong Kong Dragon Boat Festival
On June 14, the 47th Boston Hong Kong Dragon Boat Festival was held along the Charles River in Boston. Consul General Chen Li attended the event with his wife and delivered remarks.

国家移民管理局（中华人民共和国出入境管理局）于2018年4月2日组建成立，是公安部管理的国家局，为副部级。国家移民管理局领导管理全国出入境边防检查机构、边境管理机构各项工作，指导管理各省、自治区、直辖市公安机关出入境管理机构业务工作。
机构职责
    
  国家移民管理局内设：综合司(移民事务国际合作司)、政策法规司、外国人管理司、公民出入境管理司、边防检查管理司、信息科技司、干部人事司、后勤保障司等8个司。下设出入境管理信息技术研究所、移民事务服务中心和警务保障中心3个直属事业单位。
    主办单位：国家移民管理局
    网站电话：010-66265110
    通讯地址：北京市东长安街14号(邮编：100741)
